About the event

How it works.

Refract brings students together in teams of 2–5 to choose a project, build a prototype and give a short demo. Meet people outside your usual classes and make something together.

[Participant Capacity] places

2–5per team

Example: 60 students

Bring your team or meet teammates at the event. Registration closes on [Signup Deadline].

Project ideas

What will you build?

Build with software, engineering, science or a mix of all three. Here are a few starting points:

Software & AI

Build an app, try a small model, or automate something you usually do by hand.

Robotics & hardware

Make a robot, work with sensors, or build a physical prototype.

Science & data

Use a dataset or a simulation to investigate a question.

Something else

Combine subjects in one project. These examples are just a starting point.

FAQ

Questions?

What is Refract?+

Refract is a student-led hackathon at PRISMS. Work in a small team on a project, give a short demo and get feedback.

Who can participate?+

Current PRISMS students. Join a team of 2–5 or find teammates at the event. There are [Participant Capacity] places.

Does my project have to be software?+

No. Bring a software, hardware, robotics, scientific computing or data project—or combine several fields.

When and where will it happen?+

Join us at [Venue] on the PRISMS campus from [Start Date] to [End Date]. Check-in opens at [Check-in Time].

Are there prizes?+

Prize pool: [Prize Pool]. Award categories: [Prize Categories]. Judging criteria: [Judging Criteria].

How do I sign up?+

Visit the registration page, verify your email and add your name. Sign up between [Registration Opens] and [Signup Deadline].

How will the event be supervised?+

[Faculty Leads] and the student organizing team coordinate supervision, room access and lab safety. Event hours: [Event Hours]. For questions, contact [Organizer Contact].
